Exercise: Bicycling, Stationary

Category:
cardio

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
None

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- cyclical

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- machine

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- cardiovascular_fitness
- lower_body_strength_and_endurance

Contraindications:

- Recent knee or hip surgery
- Severe cardiovascular conditions

Exercise Variations:

- name: High-Resistance Interval Training, description: Increase resistance and decrease speed for short intervals.
- name: Low-Resistance Continuous Cycling, description: Maintain a steady, low-resistance pace for an extended period.

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Elliptical Trainer, equipment: machine
- exercise_name: Treadmill Walking, equipment: machine

Instructions:

- To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height.
- Select the desired option from the menu. You may have to start pedaling to turn it on. You can use the manual setting, or you can select a program to use. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. The level of resistance can be changed throughout the workout. The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.
